simulator_promotion_requirements: no published v3 base-test horizon regresses by more than two percent
v2-catalog incident-test geometric H1/H3/H5 error improves by at least five percent
v2-catalog incident-test false negatives do not increase
published v3 stress and OOD false negatives do not increase
false-positive rate remains within two percentage points
anti-collapse variance ratio remains at least 0.10

integration_policy.simulator_model: Replace the deployed PJE1 artifact only if every simulator promotion requirement passes.
integration_policy.hil_model: Keep the HAI diagnostic artifact separate from the simulator PJE1 artifact and bind it to its projection schema, dataset digests, and evaluation record.
integration_policy.authority: Neither model may grant permits or invoke physical adapters. Only deterministic policy, capability, confirmation, session, and external qualification gates may authorize delivery.

claim_boundary: Incident-derived results are simulator evidence informed by real reports, not real incident replay.
HAI results are external recorded HIL/testbed evidence, not field deployment or Ferrum-operated hardware.
A passing v4 benchmark supports a cyber-physical research-system claim; it does not support market-ready safety, certified control, or autonomous actuation claims.
